overall_summary: Data volume and view counts are currently extremely low (max 20 views). Confidence is low, so recommendations focus on repeatable narrative structures around tangible digital nostalgia rather than chasing statistical noise.

winning_patterns.pattern: Tangible digital nostalgia objects (Saved contacts, photo on profile)
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos referencing saved phone numbers and profile photos achieved the highest relative views (16-20 views) compared to generic night/tea metaphors (5 views).
winning_patterns.action: Anchor future videos on specific, highly recognizable phone screen interactions rather than abstract emotional states.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'मेज पर रखी चाय' and abstract overthinking posts stalled at 0-5 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid starting videos with generic setting descriptions; open immediately with a concrete visual action.

next_video.concept: Typing a long unsent message in a personal notes app late at night.
next_video.opening_direction: Show notes app screen typing 'आज भी तुम्हारी याद आती है...'
next_video.twist_direction: Instead of hitting send, the user selects all text, deletes it, and closes the screen to sleep.
next_video.reason: Leverages the slightly stronger performance seen around morning/midday posting (07:00 UTC) while capitalizing on tangible digital screen habits.

experiment: Testing if visual notes-app drafting (unsent text) generates higher retention than chat-app screen hooks.
